sections.title: Current Conditions
lines: Meetings occupy much of the working window.

sections.title: What’s Forming
lines: Development activity is rising while review waits lengthen and calendar space tightens. A possible review bottleneck may be forming over the next 24–48 hours.

sections.title: What We Can’t See Yet
lines: The near-term outlook has not yet been checked against real outcomes.
Review waits suggest capacity; they do not measure actual reviewer availability.
A pull request still waiting for review may ultimately wait longer.
Task size and review complexity are outside this radar.
Free calendar time does not tell us whether someone has committed to review.
How pressure differential relates to the other weather patterns remains open.
